name: item-friendship-evos
notes: Cap 25, badge 1. Exercises the evolution-legality matrix under TIEBREAKER evolution K (obtainability lives in the access gates / owned items, not in K): accessible evolutions field their best form on score — Pichu's line may reach either Raichu form (Thunder Stone, farmable; Kanto Raichu carries Pikachu's pre-evo kit — Nasty Plot / Discharge — since the pre-evo-only level-up fix, so the forms are a near-tie), Abra fields Kadabra/Alakazam (Link Stone), Gastly fields Haunter (25), Machop stays Machop (Machoke is level 28 > cap). Happiny's line may field Chansey (Oval Stone + day) or stay Happiny — but the CHANSEY LINE MUST NOT SEAT at cap 25 (invariant 2; asserted via mustNotSeat below is not possible since seating isn't asserted here — the weak-shell/happiny-swap fixtures own that guard). Fielded-form assertions pin the legality engine; no seating assertions — the pool is deliberately mixed.
